016d57ec.text:
Aman ano anu eraburis al anu falla asto're shar anu ishnu al anu dorados'no ishura al anu Alah'ni Dath. No tal osa talah thus Terro, balah al anu alah'ni d'ana'no, t'as'e tal asto're al anu anar, shano t'as'e ano ishura ri fulo fulo thus ano ishura aman nei eburi. Shar anu dorini al anu Dath tal anu eraburis al anu falla, alah'ni al Terro, turus shano turus, dath da shano thus osa mush'al aman asto're, shar anu al'shar shano.

T'as'e talah dath aman balah tal dorini al ash'therod shari'adune
016d57ec.title: The Lay of Ameth'Aran

1a152bba.text:
Anu ishnu mandalas da anu mush'al shari ni anu thori'dal neph'o dath dal'dieb tal asto're. Anu ishura tal dorini neph'o da anu aman tal thori'dal al Mandalas tal anu shari shando al anu eraburis al anu falla dath alah'ni no anu alah'ni shando. Talah osa osa talah, alah'ni dath ni anu shari'adune, ni anu terro thus osa anu alah'ni. Anu thori'dal osa asto're t'as'e dath anu thori'dal al terro, dath anu isera'duna thus ash'therod no fulo anu shano al'shar.

Mush'al t'as'e mush'al. Shando t'as'e
1a152bba.title: The Fall of Ameth'Aran

10118|c6fbc16f.name: Nessa Shadowsong
10118|c6fbc16f.text: The fish off the coast of Teldrassil are quite large and robust.  Rumors say it is the speedy growth of our new world tree that is the cause.

10219|572db4df.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
10219|572db4df.text: May Elune walk with you, $c.  The Temple of the Moon has come to help the troubled citizens of Auberdine.

11041|711bbaa2.name: Milla Fairancora
11041|711bbaa2.text: You are kind to seek me out, but your skills are beyond my own. Have a word with Sylvanna Forestmoon, just over there. She's been looking for another student.

11042|6c2d4d54.name: Sylvanna Forestmoon
11042|6c2d4d54.text: I have learned much of potions over the long years, $N, and that knowledge is at your disposal. You have only to ask.

11866|f3b1497b.name: Ilyenia Moonfire
11866|f3b1497b.text: The grace with which I fight is not something I can teach you, but I can teach you the use of various weapons.

2913|5112b624.name: Archaeologist Hollee
2913|5112b624.text: Who would have guessed the excavation would have uncovered such findings!

3616|29aa26bd.name: Onu
3616|29aa26bd.text:
The wind whispers to those who listen...

Do you hear it?

3692|6e5dc9aa.name: Volcor
3692|6e5dc9aa.text:
Well, the way I see it, $N, we have two options to consider for leaving this cave.

We can make our way stealthfully--I use the cloak you've given me, and you'd be left to your own devices, or, and this may be a harder option considering my wounds, we fight our way out back to back.

I'll let you decide since you know your strengths better than I.

3693|85fc41cc.name: Terenthis
3693|85fc41cc.text:
$N, I've come to find out how rampant the effects of Fel Moss are throughout Darkshore. The corruption of Teldrassil and our surrounding lands really concerns the druids of the Cenarian Circle, and all Night elves.

It is my goal to find out why this has happened and to put an end to it.

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

3841|ab4871bb.name: Caylais Moonfeather
3841|ab4871bb.text: The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.

4089|c8e02354.name: Sildanair
4089|c8e02354.text: I do not see the warrior's spirit within you, child.  I have no teachings which would benefit a $c such as yourself.

4160|4aeeff74.name: Ainethil
4160|4aeeff74.text: Your skill at brewing potions needs to be greater before you can become one of my students. In the meantime, perhaps Sylvanna Forestmoon or Milla Fairancora can help you, just over there.

4210|0c543544.name: Alegorn
4210|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

4210|52392408.name: Alegorn
4210|52392408.text: Seek out Shandrina in Silverwind Refuge.  She can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".

4211|33af2c00.name: Dannelor
4211|33af2c00.text: I've heard it said that Deneb Walker, holed up in Stromgarde, has a book that is sure to help improve your First Aid techniques.

6300|0b719f6c.name: Elisa Steelhand
6300|0b719f6c.text: How can I help you, friend?

6735|41276936.name: Innkeeper Saelienne
6735|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

98013-accept.name: Arbal
98013-accept.text:
Steel yourself for your time in the ruins, young one... you will not be granted free passage there.

Scores of cursed Highborne, now known as naga, roam the once great city. Travel northeast and dispatch them from this land.

What they once were... is no more. If they aid the Twilight's Hammer, they can bring only further pain to the forests that once gave them shelter.

War is what they seek, $c. War... is what we will bring.
98013-accept.title: Swelling Forces

98013-complete.name: Arbal
98013-complete.text:
Do not fret, young one. To pillage one's own home for some dark master...

It is unforgivable.
98013-complete.title: Swelling Forces

98028-accept.name: Unknown
98028-accept.text:
All that remains of the powerful elemental is a globe of what seems to be pure water, clouded by some unknown substance. The edges of the sphere seem to be clear until you turn it--as if the cloud actively prevents you from peering within.

Whatever happened to it--and to the ruins it was guarding--is still active in some way.

Only Onu, the Ancient of Lore at the Grove of the Ancients to the far south, would have a chance at knowing more.
98028-accept.title: Baron Marinous

98028-complete.name: Onu
98028-complete.text:
<Onu appears surprised--or as surprised as an ancient can appear.>

Stairs descending in Mathystra? Could it be?

<Onu shakes his head.>

I must confer with the others on this. For now, know that it is good you uncovered this before the naga... or their cult allies.

Please accept this as thanks for your efforts. It is no small feat to defeat an elemental guardian.
98028-complete.title: Baron Marinous

98028-progress.name: Onu
98028-progress.text: I can sense something far older than you in my presence, $r... what have you brought me?
98028-progress.title: Baron Marinous
